name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person's or a service's picture, with initials (or another fallback) while it loads or when there is none; circle or square in three sizes.
usage: Use Avatar beside a name: the signed-in user, who approved a grant, a connection in a list (shape="square"). name is the accessible name and the source of the initials; src is a local or data: URL, never a remote service in an air-gapped app. fallback replaces the initials (an icon). The picture shows only once loaded. For a status next to a name use Badge.

props.name: name
props.description: Accessible name and source of the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: A local or data: URL of the picture.

props.name: shape
props.description: circle for people, square for services.

props.name: fallbackDelay
props.description: ms to wait before showing the fallback.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="img" named by name; data-slot="avatar", data-size, data-shape.

slots.name: image
slots.description: The picture, alt="" (the root carries the name); data-slot="avatar-image".

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Initials or the fallback, aria-hidden; data-slot="avatar-fallback".

accessibility: The root is role="img" with aria-label from name; the picture has alt="" and the initials are aria-hidden, so the name is read once.
When the avatar sits next to the same name in text, it repeats it; that is acceptable, or pass aria-hidden on the Avatar to skip it.
Initials are color.neutral.subtle-fg on color.neutral.subtle-bg, contrast-checked by the token build.
